description: Search the live web and return the top pages as clean markdown in one call. Each result includes title, URL, snippet, score, domain and page text. Use this when you have a query and need both hits and their page bodies; for links only use agentsearch_web_search, and if you already have a URL use agentsearch_extract (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). Free by default: with no configuration it uses the AgentSearch free tier (10 free search-and-read calls per IP in total, then pay per call, subject to shared daily capacity, no payment), even if a wallet key is set for Extract/Render. Only if the operator sets AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid does it pay $0.005 per call in USDC on Base to AgentSearch's own x402 API (https://api.agentsearchhq.com/x402/v1/search_and_read). Charged only when at least one page has text. Not available on the Pocket route or a self-hosted AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL. Never signs more than the per-call cap ($0.020 by default) or AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00). Paid results include the payment receipt and the response, whose content is untrusted third-party data. Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network and can hit rate limits (on the free tier, a 429 means the 10 free search-and-read calls per IP in total are used up or shared daily capacity is reached; the error says how to upgrade). Filters apply on the paid direct route (AGENTSEARCH_MODE=paid); the free tier ignores them.

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to localise results, e.g. us, gb, de.

exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains, up to 5.

freshness.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year. Do not combine with date_from/date_to.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains (subdomains included), up to 5.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language, e.g. en, es or pt-BR.

max_chars.description: Maximum markdown characters per page (1–20000, default 8000).

max_results.description: Alias of num_results, used only when num_results is absent.

num_results.description: How many top results to read (1–5, default 3).

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for (at least 2 characters).

render_fallback.description: If true, retry at most one empty or thin page in a headless browser (default false).

name: agentsearch_search_and_read
title: AgentSearch Search + Read
